# Chavez Concrete Work Inc.

## About
Chavez Concrete Work Inc. is a family-owned commercial concrete contractor based in Durham, North Carolina, operating since 2003. We specialize in commercial flatwork and concrete solutions for general contractors and commercial construction projects across North Carolina.

## Services
- Sidewalks
- Curbs and gutters
- Concrete slabs
- Drive-thrus
- Stairs
- Commercial flatwork

## Service Area
Durham, NC and surrounding areas including Raleigh, Chapel Hill, Cary, and the greater Triangle region of North Carolina. We serve a wide radius across the state.
